name: Hydra Doc Importer
author: extascorp

sections.description:
Hydra Doc Importer turns a document into a WordPress draft in one click. No more copy and paste from Word, no more broken formatting.

Import

  • Word (.docx): headings, paragraphs, bold, italic, strikethrough, superscript, links, bulleted and numbered lists (nested too), tables, quotes and images. Images are saved in your Media Library with their alt text.
  • Text PDF: the text layer is read and rebuilt as paragraphs, headings and lists.
  • Creates a draft post or page made of core blocks (Paragraph, Heading, List, Table, Image, Quote). No custom blocks, so your content stays editable if you remove the plugin.
  • The first title of the document becomes the post title.
  • Batch import: select several files at once, each becomes its own draft.
  • Works on shared hosting: pure PHP, no command line tool, no external service.

Export

  • Markdown export of any post or page, with a small front matter (title, date, URL). Useful to feed an LLM, to archive, or to move to a static site.
  • A “Markdown” link in the Posts and Pages lists, and a Hydra Doc Importer sidebar in the block editor to import into the post you are editing, download the .md file or copy it.

Privacy

The free plugin does not contact any other website, does not track you and does not store anything except a small “_hydradoc_source” post meta with the original file name.

Hydra Doc Importer Pro (separate download) adds OCR for scanned PDFs and images, custom field mapping and scheduling.

Limits

  • PDF has no real structure: headings and lists are guessed from line spacing and bullet characters. Always read the draft before publishing.
  • PDF tables and images are not imported (Word tables and images are).
  • Footnotes, text boxes, headers and footers of Word files are ignored.
  • Files must be at most 20 MB (or your server upload limit if smaller).

External services

The free plugin makes no external request.

Third party libraries

  • smalot/pdfparser 2.x, LGPL-3.0, https://github.com/smalot/pdfparser (included in the vendor folder, unmodified).
  • symfony/polyfill-mbstring 1.x, MIT, https://github.com/symfony/polyfill (included in the vendor folder, unmodified).
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install it from the Plugins screen.
  2. Activate it.
  3. Go to Tools > Hydra Doc Importer, choose a .docx or PDF file and click “Import as draft”.
sections.faq:
Does it work with scanned PDFs?

The free version needs a PDF with a text layer (you can select the text in a PDF reader). Scanned documents need OCR, which is part of Hydra Doc Importer Pro.

Where do the images go?

Images found in a .docx file are added to the Media Library and inserted as Image blocks. Their alt text is kept when the document has one.

Which blocks are created?

Only WordPress core blocks: Paragraph, Heading, List, Table, Image and Quote.

Can I import several files at once?

The free version imports one file at a time. Batch import is in Hydra Doc Importer Pro.

Is my document sent somewhere?

No. In the free plugin everything happens on your server.

Who can import and export?

Users who can edit posts and upload files. Export needs the right to edit the post.

The headings of my PDF are wrong.

PDF files only store where each line is on the page. The plugin guesses headings from the spacing, so a PDF with unusual layout may need a quick manual fix.

Does the Markdown export include images?

Yes, as Markdown image links to your Media Library files.

1.0.0

  • First release: .docx and text PDF import (one or several files at once), Media Library images, Markdown export, block editor sidebar.

short_description: Import Word (.docx) and text PDF files as clean Gutenberg blocks, and export any post as Markdown for LLMs.
